name: DICOM Viewer MRI CT: Raykin
description:
Raykin opens the scans hospitals give you — on a CD, a USB drive, a ZIP file or a QR code — and keeps your family's X-ray, CT, MRI and ultrasound images in one private place on your iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple Watch. Everything happens on your device: no account, no ads, no tracking, nothing uploaded.

OPEN WHAT THE HOSPITAL GAVE YOU
• Files, folders, ZIP and DICOMDIR from the Files app, a USB-C drive or AirDrop
• Hospital QR codes and links: DICOM and ZIP files download straight into Raykin
• On Mac, insert the hospital CD: Raykin copies it first and never runs programs from the disc
• A photo of an old film, or a scanned paper report
• Scans are sorted into people and visits for you

SEE IT CLEARLY
• Scroll through slices, adjust brightness and contrast with presets, zoom, rotate and invert
• Play ultrasound and other moving images
• Compare up to 4 images, with cross-reference lines and a mini-map
• The hospital's saved views and marks, shown as saved
• A plain-language Series Explainer and glossary: what an MRI sequence or CT series shows
• Show the Doctor: one visit full screen; leaving it needs Face ID or your passcode

KEEP TRACK
• Star key images and keep notes
• Follow-up reminders with a checklist of questions for the doctor, and Add to Calendar
• An Imaging Notes card for implants, allergies and past contrast reactions, also on Apple Watch

RAYKIN PRO
• Unlimited family members (2 are free)
• Then & Now: compare two dates side by side, with flicker and blend, kept in position
• Measurements in mm, angles, areas and CT density (HU)
• MPR in any plane and 3D volume rendering
• Clean Share: a copy without names, IDs or birth dates, dates shifted, burned-in text flagged for you to cover — as a ZIP, images, a video or a second-opinion PDF packet
• Smart Search in plain words
Try every Pro feature free on the built-in sample family.

ON EVERY APPLE DEVICE
• Apple Watch: next follow-up, Imaging Notes and the key images you choose
• Widgets, Lock Screen, Live Activities, Control Center, Siri and Shortcuts
• Mac: Quick Look previews and Finder thumbnails for DICOM files, menu bar helper, drag and drop
• Nearby Transfer between your own devices, end-to-end encrypted, never through the internet
• Encrypted Raykin Archive backups with your own passphrase
• 12 languages: English, Tiếng Việt, Español, Português, Deutsch, Français, Italiano, 日本語, 한국어, 简体中文 and 繁體中文 — switch inside the app

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
Face ID lock, per-person lock, hidden details on widgets and the Watch, and a warning when the screen is being recorded. Data Not Collected.

PRICES
Raykin Pro: weekly, monthly or yearly subscription, or a one-time Lifetime purchase that works with Family Sharing. Prices are shown in the app in your currency. Subscriptions renew automatically unless canceled at least 24 hours before the end of the period; manage or cancel them in Settings › Apple Account › Subscriptions. Payment is charged to your Apple Account at confirmation.

Educational Disclaimer
This app is for educational purposes only and does not provide medical diagnosis, treatment, or professional medical advice.
